title: Check federation join generation overflow before mutating binding and directory
outcome: join_federation_mailbox_session computes federation_next_generation after assigning the session binding and inserting its directory participant. With an exhausted version, the returned conflict leaves partial in-memory mutation without persistence/version settlement. Move the fallible generation computation before mutation and verify refusal is atomic.
acceptance: An exhausted federation version causes local join to refuse before changing session binding, directory, federation version or durability state.
A regression covers the exhausted-version refusal and preserves the successful join behavior.
